data.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase E to recognize recipe: task type and route it through recipe-executor.sh instead of sub-agent dispatch.

## Why
Instruction-file update: the sprint orchestrator needs explicit routing logic for recipe: tasks — the existing testing_mode dispatch table only handles RED/GREEN/UPDATE.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase E testing_mode dispatch table gains a new row: recipe: → execute via recipe-executor.sh (no sub-agent dispatch)
- Phase E recipe: execution flow instructs the orchestrator to:
  1. Parse recipe_name, recipe_params (key=value pairs), and intent from task description
  2. Call: bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/../scripts/recipe-executor.sh <recipe_name> [--param key=value ...]
  3. Capture stdout JSON; on bash-level failure or empty output, synthesize error JSON
  4. Call: bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/sprint/format-recipe-result.sh <recipe_name> <<< <executor_JSON>
  5. Record summary in sprint log as task result
  6. If exit_code=1 in JSON: mark task failed, log error summary, continue batch (do not crash sprint)
  7. If degraded=true: log degraded warning with engine_name and fallback note
- Phase E recipe: path does NOT create a story branch (recipe tasks are direct — no sub-branch worktree needed)
- Existing RED/GREEN/UPDATE routing remains unchanged
- Existing tests remain still-valid (SKILL.md is instruction-only)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — instruction-file change; tests still-valid

## Dependencies
- format-recipe-result.sh task (depends_on)
data.title: UPDATE: Add recipe: task routing to sprint Phase E dispatch
